merchant_revenue_summary.description: Calculates total successful revenue and transaction count grouped by merchant name and city.
merchant_revenue_summary.sql:
SELECT m.merchant_name, m.city, COUNT(DISTINCT t.txn_id) AS total_txns, ROUND(SUM(t.amount), 2) AS total_revenue
                FROM upi_transactions t
                JOIN merchants m ON t.merchant_id = m.merchant_id
                WHERE UPPER(t.txn_status) IN ('SUCCESS', 'COMPLETED', 'DONE') AND t.amount > 0
                GROUP BY m.merchant_name, m.city
                ORDER BY total_revenue DESC;

bank_failure_breakdown.description: Shows failed transaction count and failure error codes grouped by bank.
bank_failure_breakdown.sql:
SELECT UPPER(bank_name) AS bank, error_code, COUNT(DISTINCT txn_id) AS failed_count
                FROM upi_transactions
                WHERE UPPER(txn_status) IN ('FAILED', 'FAIL')
                GROUP BY UPPER(bank_name), error_code
                ORDER BY failed_count DESC;

category_wise_volume.description: Shows total transaction volume across different merchant categories (Grocery, Electronics, Travel, etc.).
category_wise_volume.sql:
SELECT m.category, COUNT(DISTINCT t.txn_id) AS txn_count, ROUND(SUM(t.amount), 2) AS volume
                FROM upi_transactions t
                JOIN merchants m ON t.merchant_id = m.merchant_id
                WHERE t.amount > 0
                GROUP BY m.category
                ORDER BY volume DESC;

city_wise_performance.description: Compares total transactions and total successful revenue across cities.
city_wise_performance.sql:
SELECT m.city, COUNT(DISTINCT t.txn_id) AS total_txns, ROUND(SUM(t.amount), 2) AS total_revenue
                FROM upi_transactions t
                JOIN merchants m ON t.merchant_id = m.merchant_id
                WHERE UPPER(t.txn_status) IN ('SUCCESS', 'COMPLETED', 'DONE') AND t.amount > 0
                GROUP BY m.city
                ORDER BY total_revenue DESC;
